The texture around the steam holes appears slightly soft and lacks the crisp, machined precision expected of real metal perforations; edges bleed slightly into the surrounding metal.
The connection between the power cord and the iron body is somewhat ambiguous and lacks a clear strain relief or plug housing, appearing to merge softly with the casing.

To rigorously analyze the illegible text on the soleplate sticker, which is a strong indicator of AI generation.
To check for seamless integration between the metal plate and plastic body, ensuring no floating elements or boundary bleeding.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the red sticker on the bottom. Real irons have clear safety ratings or brand logos; AI often generates garbled text here. Also, inspect the steam holes—are they perfectly circular and uniform, or do they vary in shape/size unnaturally? Check if the reflection on the metal soleplate matches the implied lighting source.
